msg: do not focus on what gnome leads to what basket as working that out consumed many 1.5 second intervals for me. Finger placement is key. The 1.5 seconds is the biggest hurdle to overcome in this game in my opinion, be mindful that a glance above your laptop screen, will take 1.5 seconds, scratching your eyebrow takes 1.5 seconds so be mindful to stay focused and press the correct key. Even pressing the wrong key will take up the 1.5 seconds. The gnome colour, height does not seem to correlate to the points earned consistently. For me the advice given about which colour/height gnome leads to what basket, was not the experience I had. for example the advice i was given focused on the red baskets providing more points initially but for myself it was the yellow basket.
